approvalEvidence.statement: The user explicitly said to proceed after confirming one complete Cursor-like workspace Agent experience that embeds the real interactive Pi chat rather than recreating it.

requirement.initialIntent: Provide one completed Cursor-like Agent screen that follows the IDE's existing active workspace while keeping the chat, tools, commands, extensions, trust, models, and session behavior native to interactive Pi.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The existing IDE Workspace Registry remains authoritative; no parallel workspace system is introduced.
The Files activity reuses the existing workspace file explorer and opens files in the existing main editor.
The Agent activity embeds the real interactive Pi TUI through a persistent PTY whose working directory is the exact active workspace root.
The IDE does not mirror or own Pi chat messages, tool calls, commands, extension dialogs, model state, trust, compaction, retry, or session history.
Switching workspace attaches the Agent screen to that workspace's Pi PTY/session; returning restores the original live PTY without cross-workspace input or output leakage.
Pi processes may continue while their workspace is not visible and expose an honest running or exited status.
The same Agent screen contains accessory Changes, Activity, Resources, and Sessions views; structured metadata is accessory and never substitutes for Pi chat.
The Agent screen can detach into one larger workspace-pinned window and attach to the same PTY/session.
Closing or hiding either Agent view detaches only the renderer and never writes EOF, sends a termination signal, or stops Pi.
Only a separate explicit confirmed Stop Pi action terminates the workspace's live Pi process.
The embedded terminal forwards raw Pi input, ANSI output, resize, paste, and modified Enter key sequences without a synthetic shell prompt or command parser.
Installed Pi packages and discoverable commands are visible as read-only accessory metadata, including packages that register no slash command.
The completed acceptance proves workspace A to B to A continuity, detached-window closure without process termination, explicit stop, file navigation, and absence of cross-workspace leakage.

qualityConstraints: Deliver one completed vertical milestone rather than presenting intermediate technical slices as user features.
Use focused tests during implementation and one integrated end-to-end acceptance at completion.
Do not fix unrelated repository findings without explicit user authorization.
Keep reusable UI free of direct Tauri imports; native process and window authority remain behind ports and adapters.
Use fixed executable selection and argument construction; never pass project data through a shell command string.
Generated artifacts and user-facing product text are English.
exclusions: Reimplementing Pi chat or Pi's agent runtime in React, Rust, RPC, or an SDK sidecar
Creating a second workspace registry or duplicating file explorer/editor authority
Using RPC as the chat, message-history, tool, or extension-UI authority
Installing, removing, updating, or enabling Pi packages
Terminating Pi when a panel, tab, detached window, or workspace view is closed
Unrelated dependency, documentation, formatting, or repository-wide cleanup
